headline: Sensex surges and Nifty crosses 25,100 as Dalal Street begins Samvat 2083 on a bullish note during Muhurat Trading.

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Dalal Street starts Samvat 2083 on a bullish note as Muhurat Trading begins with broad-based buying.
Indian equities bucked global market gloom and tech selloffs, recording their best week in six years.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) stepped up India buying, helping Nifty reclaim the 25,000 mark.
Strong rallies in headline gainers like Sun Pharma, Tata Steel, and Finolex Cables boosted market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 400 points and Nifty crossed the 25,100 mark during the Diwali Muhurat Trading session.
Finolex Cables jumped 17% as trading for Samvat 2083 commenced.
Sun Pharma and Tata Steel emerged as top gainers headline-ing index advances.
IPO lock-in expiries are scheduled for LEAP India, Technocraft Ventures, Dhoot Transmission, and Molbio Diagnostics from Nov 9-13.
summary: Dalal Street kicked off Samvat 2083 on a strong note with the Sensex surging nearly 400 points and Nifty crossing 25,100 during the special Muhurat Trading session. Sun Pharma and Tata Steel headlined major gains, while Finolex Cables jumped 17%. Indian markets continue to demonstrate resilience by bucking global market weakness.
